# chat-to-docx

> Convert AI chat transcripts and Markdown into Word DOCX with editable OMML equations.


## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/xggqqwd-Lucas/chat-to-docx/blob/main/README.md): Installation, usage and dependencies.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/xggqqwd-Lucas/chat-to-docx/blob/main/SKILL.md): Agent workflow.
- [Equation workflow](https://github.com/xggqqwd-Lucas/chat-to-docx/blob/main/references/equation-workflow.md): MathML to OMML.
- [Example](https://github.com/xggqqwd-Lucas/chat-to-docx/blob/main/examples/chat-with-equations.md): Fourier transform, wavelets, normalization and cross-entropy.

## Environment

Python, python-docx, lxml and the local Office MML2OMML.XSL stylesheet. The helper converts MathML; an agent handles source parsing and document assembly.
